convention: joint at the origin; left branch for x <= 0, right branch for x >= 0; curvature signed in the plane

cases.right: circle radius 5.0 tangent at origin (y = R - sqrt(R^2 - x^2))

cases.derivation: kappa = 6x/(1+9x^4)^1.5 -> 0 at x=0; dkappa/ds at 0 = 6 vs 0 on the line

bezier_g2_rule: cubic Beziers P0..P3 | Q0..Q3 with P3 = Q0: G1 iff P2, P3, Q1 collinear with P3 between; curvature at an end = (n-1)/n * |d1 x d2| / |d1|^3 with d1 = P3-P2, d2 = P2-P1 (n = 3): kappa_end = 2/3 * |(P3-P2) x (P1-P2)| / |P3-P2|^3  (Piegl & Tiller / Farin)
